cold_email.subject: Interest in Part-Time Educator / Whalers Village — biology/bioinformatics graduate
cold_email.body:
Dear lululemon Hiring Team,

My name is Celina Lin, and I recently completed my Honours Bachelor of Science in Biology/Bioinformatics at the University of Waterloo. I am reaching out about the Part-Time Educator / Whalers Village opportunity with lululemon at lululemon.

I am especially interested in the team's use of quantitative and computational methods to answer meaningful biological questions. In my independent BRCA1/BRCA2 project, I built a reproducible Python and Snakemake workflow using BCFtools and ANNOVAR to analyze population-specific variants and examine discrepancies between clinical labels and observed allele frequencies. I also completed two bioinformatics internships at the Ontario Institute for Cancer Research, where I developed an LLM-assisted competency-mapping pipeline and created research-data-management learning resources. More broadly, my background in biology, bioinformatics, Python, R, SQL, Linux, and reproducible workflow development aligns well with that kind of cross-disciplinary work.

The combination of rigorous biological questions, collaborative research, and hands-on computational work in this role is exactly the environment in which I hope to grow. I would be grateful for a 15–20 minute conversation to learn more about the lab's current priorities and discuss where my background could be useful. I have attached my resume for context.

Best,
Celina Lin
https://linkedin.com/in/celina-g-lin

cold_email.subject: Interest in Associate Research Administrator — biology/bioinformatics graduate
cold_email.body:
Dear Northwestern University Hiring Team,

My name is Celina Lin, and I recently completed my Honours Bachelor of Science in Biology/Bioinformatics at the University of Waterloo. I am reaching out about the Associate Research Administrator opportunity with Northwestern University at Northwestern University.

I am especially interested in the team's use of quantitative and computational methods to answer meaningful biological questions. In my independent BRCA1/BRCA2 project, I built a reproducible Python and Snakemake workflow using BCFtools and ANNOVAR to analyze population-specific variants and examine discrepancies between clinical labels and observed allele frequencies. I also completed two bioinformatics internships at the Ontario Institute for Cancer Research, where I developed an LLM-assisted competency-mapping pipeline and created research-data-management learning resources. More broadly, my background in biology, bioinformatics, Python, R, SQL, Linux, and reproducible workflow development aligns well with that kind of cross-disciplinary work.

The combination of rigorous biological questions, collaborative research, and hands-on computational work in this role is exactly the environment in which I hope to grow. I would be grateful for a 15–20 minute conversation to learn more about the lab's current priorities and discuss where my background could be useful. I have attached my resume for context.

Best,
Celina Lin
https://linkedin.com/in/celina-g-lin

cold_email.subject: Interest in Evening Hotel Guest Service Representative — biology/bioinformatics graduate
cold_email.body:
Dear NCG Hospitality Hiring Team,

My name is Celina Lin, and I recently completed my Honours Bachelor of Science in Biology/Bioinformatics at the University of Waterloo. I am reaching out about the Evening Hotel Guest Service Representative opportunity with NCG Hospitality at NCG Hospitality.

I am especially interested in the team's use of quantitative and computational methods to answer meaningful biological questions. In my independent BRCA1/BRCA2 project, I built a reproducible Python and Snakemake workflow using BCFtools and ANNOVAR to analyze population-specific variants and examine discrepancies between clinical labels and observed allele frequencies. I also completed two bioinformatics internships at the Ontario Institute for Cancer Research, where I developed an LLM-assisted competency-mapping pipeline and created research-data-management learning resources. More broadly, my background in biology, bioinformatics, Python, R, SQL, Linux, and reproducible workflow development aligns well with that kind of cross-disciplinary work.

The combination of rigorous biological questions, collaborative research, and hands-on computational work in this role is exactly the environment in which I hope to grow. I would be grateful for a 15–20 minute conversation to learn more about the lab's current priorities and discuss where my background could be useful. I have attached my resume for context.

Best,
Celina Lin

cold_email.subject: Interest in Clinical Research Coordinator — biology/bioinformatics graduate
cold_email.body:
Dear Elite Clinical Network Hiring Team,

My name is Celina Lin, and I recently completed my Honours Bachelor of Science in Biology/Bioinformatics at the University of Waterloo. I am reaching out about the Clinical Research Coordinator opportunity with Elite Clinical Network at Elite Clinical Network.

I am especially interested in the team's use of quantitative and computational methods to answer meaningful biological questions. In my independent BRCA1/BRCA2 project, I built a reproducible Python and Snakemake workflow using BCFtools and ANNOVAR to analyze population-specific variants and examine discrepancies between clinical labels and observed allele frequencies. I also completed two bioinformatics internships at the Ontario Institute for Cancer Research, where I developed an LLM-assisted competency-mapping pipeline and created research-data-management learning resources. More broadly, my background in biology, bioinformatics, Python, R, SQL, Linux, and reproducible workflow development aligns well with that kind of cross-disciplinary work.

The combination of rigorous biological questions, collaborative research, and hands-on computational work in this role is exactly the environment in which I hope to grow. I would be grateful for a 15–20 minute conversation to learn more about the lab's current priorities and discuss where my background could be useful. I have attached my resume for context.

Best,
Celina Lin
https://linkedin.com/in/celina-g-lin

cold_email.subject: Interest in QA Lab Technician (Swing Shift) Pasco, WA — biology/bioinformatics graduate
cold_email.body:
Dear Simplot Company Hiring Team,

My name is Celina Lin, and I recently completed my Honours Bachelor of Science in Biology/Bioinformatics at the University of Waterloo. I am reaching out about the QA Lab Technician (Swing Shift) Pasco, WA opportunity with Simplot Company at Simplot Company.

I am especially interested in the team's use of quantitative and computational methods to answer meaningful biological questions. In my independent BRCA1/BRCA2 project, I built a reproducible Python and Snakemake workflow using BCFtools and ANNOVAR to analyze population-specific variants and examine discrepancies between clinical labels and observed allele frequencies. I also completed two bioinformatics internships at the Ontario Institute for Cancer Research, where I developed an LLM-assisted competency-mapping pipeline and created research-data-management learning resources. More broadly, my background in biology, bioinformatics, Python, R, SQL, Linux, and reproducible workflow development aligns well with that kind of cross-disciplinary work.

The combination of rigorous biological questions, collaborative research, and hands-on computational work in this role is exactly the environment in which I hope to grow. I would be grateful for a 15–20 minute conversation to learn more about the lab's current priorities and discuss where my background could be useful. I have attached my resume for context.

Best,
Celina Lin
https://linkedin.com/in/celina-g-lin

cold_email.subject: Interest in Research Technician, Quality Assurance (Boston) — biology/bioinformatics graduate
cold_email.body:
Dear ENAI Hiring Team,

My name is Celina Lin, and I recently completed my Honours Bachelor of Science in Biology/Bioinformatics at the University of Waterloo. I am reaching out about the Research Technician, Quality Assurance (Boston) opportunity with ENAI at ENAI.

I am especially interested in the team's use of quantitative and computational methods to answer meaningful biological questions. In my independent BRCA1/BRCA2 project, I built a reproducible Python and Snakemake workflow using BCFtools and ANNOVAR to analyze population-specific variants and examine discrepancies between clinical labels and observed allele frequencies. I also completed two bioinformatics internships at the Ontario Institute for Cancer Research, where I developed an LLM-assisted competency-mapping pipeline and created research-data-management learning resources. More broadly, my background in biology, bioinformatics, Python, R, SQL, Linux, and reproducible workflow development aligns well with that kind of cross-disciplinary work.

The combination of rigorous biological questions, collaborative research, and hands-on computational work in this role is exactly the environment in which I hope to grow. I would be grateful for a 15–20 minute conversation to learn more about the lab's current priorities and discuss where my background could be useful. I have attached my resume for context.

Best,
Celina Lin

cold_email.subject: Interest in Facility Trainer, Metro Kitchen — biology/bioinformatics graduate
cold_email.body:
Dear Whole Foods Market Hiring Team,

My name is Celina Lin, and I recently completed my Honours Bachelor of Science in Biology/Bioinformatics at the University of Waterloo. I am reaching out about the Facility Trainer, Metro Kitchen opportunity with Whole Foods Market at Whole Foods Market.

I am especially interested in the team's use of quantitative and computational methods to answer meaningful biological questions. In my independent BRCA1/BRCA2 project, I built a reproducible Python and Snakemake workflow using BCFtools and ANNOVAR to analyze population-specific variants and examine discrepancies between clinical labels and observed allele frequencies. I also completed two bioinformatics internships at the Ontario Institute for Cancer Research, where I developed an LLM-assisted competency-mapping pipeline and created research-data-management learning resources. More broadly, my background in biology, bioinformatics, Python, R, SQL, Linux, and reproducible workflow development aligns well with that kind of cross-disciplinary work.

The combination of rigorous biological questions, collaborative research, and hands-on computational work in this role is exactly the environment in which I hope to grow. I would be grateful for a 15–20 minute conversation to learn more about the lab's current priorities and discuss where my background could be useful. I have attached my resume for context.

Best,
Celina Lin
https://linkedin.com/in/celina-g-lin

cold_email.subject: Interest in The Behavior Change Agency](http://rescueagency.com) — biology/bioinformatics graduate
cold_email.body:
Dear [Rescue Hiring Team,

My name is Celina Lin, and I recently completed my Honours Bachelor of Science in Biology/Bioinformatics at the University of Waterloo. I am reaching out about the The Behavior Change Agency](http://rescueagency.com) opportunity with [Rescue at [Rescue.

I am especially interested in the team's use of quantitative and computational methods to answer meaningful biological questions. In my independent BRCA1/BRCA2 project, I built a reproducible Python and Snakemake workflow using BCFtools and ANNOVAR to analyze population-specific variants and examine discrepancies between clinical labels and observed allele frequencies. I also completed two bioinformatics internships at the Ontario Institute for Cancer Research, where I developed an LLM-assisted competency-mapping pipeline and created research-data-management learning resources. More broadly, my background in biology, bioinformatics, Python, R, SQL, Linux, and reproducible workflow development aligns well with that kind of cross-disciplinary work.

The combination of rigorous biological questions, collaborative research, and hands-on computational work in this role is exactly the environment in which I hope to grow. I would be grateful for a 15–20 minute conversation to learn more about the lab's current priorities and discuss where my background could be useful. I have attached my resume for context.

Best,
Celina Lin
https://linkedin.com/in/celina-g-lin

cold_email.subject: Interest in Youth Development Officer - Part-time (Weekends Only) — biology/bioinformatics graduate
cold_email.body:
Dear NEOGOV Hiring Team,

My name is Celina Lin, and I recently completed my Honours Bachelor of Science in Biology/Bioinformatics at the University of Waterloo. I am reaching out about the Youth Development Officer - Part-time (Weekends Only) opportunity with NEOGOV at NEOGOV.

I am especially interested in the team's use of quantitative and computational methods to answer meaningful biological questions. In my independent BRCA1/BRCA2 project, I built a reproducible Python and Snakemake workflow using BCFtools and ANNOVAR to analyze population-specific variants and examine discrepancies between clinical labels and observed allele frequencies. I also completed two bioinformatics internships at the Ontario Institute for Cancer Research, where I developed an LLM-assisted competency-mapping pipeline and created research-data-management learning resources. More broadly, my background in biology, bioinformatics, Python, R, SQL, Linux, and reproducible workflow development aligns well with that kind of cross-disciplinary work.

The combination of rigorous biological questions, collaborative research, and hands-on computational work in this role is exactly the environment in which I hope to grow. I would be grateful for a 15–20 minute conversation to learn more about the lab's current priorities and discuss where my background could be useful. I have attached my resume for context.

Best,
Celina Lin
https://linkedin.com/in/celina-g-lin

jobs.title: Therapeutic Area Analytics & Insights Manager - Solid Tumor
jobs.description: Why Genentech We’re passionate about delivering on Our Promise to improve the lives of patients and create healthier communities for all. We foster a culture of inclusivity, integrity and creativity while boldly pursuing answers to the world’s most complex health challenges and transforming society. Who We Are Our Data, Digital, and Analytics (DDA) team is dedicated to solving complex healthcare challenges and improving patient outcomes. Our Data, Digital, and Analytics empowers business partners across Commercial, Medical, and Government Affairs (CMG) to make impactful decisions by leveraging data, analytics, business products, and AI/ML to enable fast, targeted actions in rapidly evolving business contexts. DDA fosters a unified understanding of customers, actions, and outcomes by integrating analytics and insights seamlessly into CMG’s evolving digital, data, and automation platforms, creating scalable solutions and eliminating silos. In DDA you will work as a trusted, objective advisor and expert, recommending critical decisions and actions to be taken with credibility and a focus on driving measurable impact. You will be part of a thriving culture built on collaboration and innovation. Job Summary The Therapeutic Area Analytics & Insights Manager - Solid Tumor is a strategic advisor to key stakeholders and an integral contributor to Genentech’s Commercial, Medical, and Government Affairs (CMG) planning efforts. This individual supports the delivery of actionable insights and strategic recommendations to inform timely and critical business decisions across therapeutic areas, ecosystems, and/or business domains. This role involves collaborating with stakeholders to understand business needs, conducting targeted analyses to uncover tailored insights, and synthesizing findings into strategic options aligned with organizational goals. Work will guide decisions that affect in-line, pipeline, and/or business development assets. As an Individual Contributor, this individual is responsible for providing strategic recommendations with significant guidance / supervision, leveraging their capabilities. The Manager works flexibly within a matrix structure, sensing business priorities and reprioritizing work to meet organizational objectives responsible for delivering high-impact, data-driven insights that address key business challenges and support Genentech’s strategic objectives. The Manager plays a key role in integrating analytical products into workflows and enhancing organizational efficiency through best practices and automation. Key Responsibilities ● Perform custom analyses by applying appropriate analytic techniques to address business challenges. ● Take an enterprise mindset, linking individual responsibilities with broader organization; focus on outcomes that provide most business and patient value. ● Contribute to continuous organizational improvement by sharing best practices, identifying opportunities for automation, and enhancing the efficiency and impact of analytic workflows. ● Play an active role in the adoption of analytical products by staying up to date on the product roadmap, participating in training, user testing (as needed), and providing constructive feedback to ensure products are integrated into workflows. Embed and integrate products into workflows and foster Data, Analytics, and AI's product-first culture. ● Actively contribute to the community of practice by sharing knowledge, participating in discussions, and supporting peers to enhance collective expertise and drive continuous improvement. ● Balances individual, stakeholder, and department priorities to manage and shape own workload ● Build proficiency in tailoring communication to specific audiences, communicating and influencing stakeholders to secure buy-in ● Demonstrates the ability to independently handle project tasks, and proactively seeks managerial guidance as needed. Proactively identifies risks and seeks manager input to drive positive project outcomes. This role will primarily support launch readiness & execution efforts for Giredestrant in hormone receptor-positive breast cancer, with a focus on primary insights & revenue forecasting capabilities. Primary Market Research Conduct qualitative and quantitative market research with patients, caregivers, healthcare providers, and other stakeholders in the healthcare ecosystem to assess and improve the patient experience Expertise in designing and fielding qualitative and quantitative primary market research plans. Experience synthesizing concise summaries focused on the key insights that inform business decisions. Proficiency in understanding market landscape and surfacing insights across multiple primary data sources. Forecasting Lead long term patient-based revenue forecasting for indications associated with Giredestrant. Collaborate with other forecasters supporting Giredestrant and the Solid Tumor portfolio to enable consistency and holistic understanding of the business. Conduct scenario planning, sensitivity testing, and uncertainty analyses to inform strategic decisions across commercial planning, portfolio prioritization, and lifecycle management. Translate complex market dynamics into robust forecast assumptions and modeling frameworks. Stakeholder Collaboration & Influence Collaborate closely with cross-functional stakeholders to understand evolving business needs and translate them into analytical questions and modeling approaches. Develop clear strategic recommendations by synthesizing insights across analytics, forecasting outputs, competitive dynamics, and market trends. Effectively communicate insights and recommendations to both technical and non-technical audiences, influencing key stakeholders and enabling data-driven decision making. ● Comply with all laws, regulations and policies that govern the conduct of Genentech activities. Who You Are Minimum Candidate Qualifications & Experience ● 3 years of relevant work experience (or equivalent with advanced education) ● Bachelor's Degree. ● Growth Mindset. ● Experience synthesizing concise summaries focused on the key insights that inform business decisions. ● Comfortable dealing with uncertainty in a highly-matrixed organization. ● Strong results orientation and adaptability in a fast-paced environment. ● Persuasive written and verbal communication skills. Additional Desired Candidate Qualifications & Experience ● Experience with conducting primary insights projects (e.g. market research with various external stakeholder audiences) and/or revenue forecasting & patient-based market modeling ● Experience in the Breast Cancer or Oncology therapeutic area. ● Degree in Business, Economics, Engineering, Statistics, Life Sciences, Mathematics, Computer or Physical Sciences or related field. ● Proficiency in understanding market landscape and surfacing insights across multiple primary data sources. Location ●This position is based in South San Francisco, CA and relocation benefits are not available. cold_email.subject: Interest in Therapeutic Area Analytics & Insights Manager - Solid Tumor — biology/bioinformatics graduate
cold_email.body:
Dear Genentech / Roche Hiring Team,

My name is Celina Lin, and I recently completed my Honours Bachelor of Science in Biology/Bioinformatics at the University of Waterloo. I am reaching out about the Therapeutic Area Analytics & Insights Manager - Solid Tumor opportunity with Genentech / Roche at Genentech / Roche.

I am especially interested in the team's use of quantitative and computational methods to answer meaningful biological questions. In my independent BRCA1/BRCA2 project, I built a reproducible Python and Snakemake workflow using BCFtools and ANNOVAR to analyze population-specific variants and examine discrepancies between clinical labels and observed allele frequencies. I also completed two bioinformatics internships at the Ontario Institute for Cancer Research, where I developed an LLM-assisted competency-mapping pipeline and created research-data-management learning resources. More broadly, my background in biology, bioinformatics, Python, R, SQL, Linux, and reproducible workflow development aligns well with that kind of cross-disciplinary work.

The combination of rigorous biological questions, collaborative research, and hands-on computational work in this role is exactly the environment in which I hope to grow. I would be grateful for a 15–20 minute conversation to learn more about the lab's current priorities and discuss where my background could be useful. I have attached my resume for context.

Best,
Celina Lin
https://linkedin.com/in/celina-g-lin

jobs.title: Scientist, Rare Disease Biology
jobs.description: Career Category Research Job Description Join Amgen’s Mission of Serving Patients At Amgen, if you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission—to serve patients living with serious illnesses—drives all that we do. Since 1980, we’ve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world’s toughest diseases. With our focus on four therapeutic areas –Oncology, Inflammation, General Medicine, and Rare Disease– we reach millions of patients each year. Amgen is advancing a broad and deep pipeline of medicines to treat cancer, heart disease, inflammatory conditions, rare diseases, and obesity and obesity-related conditions. As a member of the Amgen team, you’ll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives. Our award-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lay within them, you’ll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career. Position: Scientist, Rare Disease Biology What you will do Let’s do this. Let’s change the world. In this vital role you will contribute to the discovery and advancement of innovative therapies for rare diseases by serving as a core member of multidisciplinary disease-focused research teams. You will apply experimental and data-driven approaches to investigate disease mechanisms, evaluate novel therapeutic targets, and generate insights that inform portfolio decisions. This role offers a unique opportunity to establish and leverage advanced human cellular disease models, including iPSC-based systems, to support discovery efforts across rare diseases. Design, execute, analyze, and interpret in vitro and ex vivo studies to investigate disease mechanisms and evaluate therapeutic hypotheses. Generate high-quality experimental data to support target identification, validation, and progression of rare disease research programs. Investigate molecular and cellular mechanisms associated with transcriptional dysregulation, protein aggregation, cellular stress responses, and impairment of neurological and neuromuscular processes. Establish scalable experimental platforms that can support multiple rare disease programs. Integrate experimental findings with published literature, human genetics, clinical observations, and other data sources to develop mechanistic insights and inform scientific decision-making. Serve as an active member of disease-focused research pods, collaborating closely with disease biologists, computational scientists, translational researchers, and partner functions. Participate in scientific discussions, target reviews, and portfolio evaluations by contributing data-driven insights and recommendations. Build and maintain productive relationships with internal and external collaborators, including academic partners, foundations, and scientific experts when appropriate. Present scientific findings and recommendations to project teams, governance forums, and departmental meetings. Maintain accurate documentation and contribute to organizational knowledge-sharing efforts. Embrace and contribute to a culture of scientific curiosity, collaboration, continuous learning, and operational excellence. What we expect of you We are all different, yet we all use our unique contributions to serve patients. The professional we seek is a Scientist with the following qualifications: Basic Qualifications PhD in Immunology, Neurology, Cell Biology, Molecular Biology, Pharmacology, Biomedical Sciences, or related discipline OR Master's degree and 3 years of scientific research experience OR Bachelor's degree and 5 years of scientific research experience Preferred Qualifications Experience in neurobiology, genetic disease biology, or related therapeutic areas. Experience studying mechanisms associated with protein aggregation, RNA toxicity, gene silencing, cellular stress responses, or neurological and neuromuscular disease processes. Demonstrated expertise developing, maintaining, and utilizing iPSC-derived cellular models. Experience with neuronal differentiation, glial cell systems, organoid models, or other advanced human cellular systems. Experience working with patient-derived cellular models and genetically engineered cellular systems. Familiarity with CRISPR-based approaches, gene editing, or functional genomics technologies is desirable. Scientific curiosity and enthusiasm for exploring emerging disease areas and technologies. Demonstrated ability to combine experimental and computational approaches to scientific problem-solving. Experience working effectively within highly collaborative and matrixed research environments. Ability to balance scientific rigor with urgency and adaptability in a dynamic research environment. Demonstrated commitment to teamwork, knowledge sharing, and continuous improvement. Familiarity with AI-enabled scientific tools, image analysis workflows, computational biology approaches, or advanced data analytics. Work in partnership with and/or escalate to the SCP to ensure quality of site delivery; Interface with the study team as needed, facilitate information flow between members of the study team, vendors and assigned investigator sites; Partner with SCP to perform investigator site development, coaching and training of site personnel to ensure ongoing compliance with protocol and the safeguarding of patients; provide protocol training to, and address protocol related questions from the investigator site staff when required, including discussions on known/anticipated operational and clinical trial risks; Attend investigator meetings when required (virtual or F2F); Provide enrollment support and ensure progress by responding to site activation and recruitment issues from investigators. diagnostic methods Independently develops plans, generates ideas, and advances research objectives with minimal oversight Plans and executes complex laboratory experiments, analyzes data, and applies insights to guide and refine project direction Defines project plans with stakeholder input and coordinates efforts to achieve milestones within established timelines Coordinates the execution and jobs.description: ABOUT RAMP Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $200B in annualized spend flows in and out of 70,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books. The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving. We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome. The median Ramp customer saves 5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same. If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it. ABOUT THE ROLE Technical Consultants are on the frontlines working to establish partnerships with Ramp customers, and act as a liaison between customers and our internal technical teams. You’ll be partnering with Customer Activation & Account Management teams to identify, prioritize and build financial solutions for new and existing customers so that Ramp continues to scale with their needs. You will act as the technical and financial subject matter expert for our customers, and design solutions that address the customer’s needs through Ramp and partner integrations. You will partner with Post-Sales teams to drive Product, Design and Engineering teams’ roadmaps to evolve Ramp to better serve our customers at scale and offer increasingly higher value to the customers. You will define the customer’s financial & technical success criteria from onboarding through activation and expansion. You will represent Product, Design and Engineering externally and will operate with deep conviction and understanding of Ramp’s technical capabilities. The role requires technical skills necessary to understand and educate on robust accounting features, and integrate them across all the touchpoints and surface area of a customer. jobs.title: Lead Biostatistician (Oncology Clinical Studies)
jobs.description: This is an exciting opportunity for a highly experienced, independent clinical biostatistician to advance adoption of Natera’s oncology portfolio of cutting-edge molecular diagnostic tests. As a Lead Biostatistician, you will independently lead the design, analysis, and reporting for multiple practice-changing oncology clinical trials. You will propose efficient, fit-for-purpose study designs with broad impact across the oncology portfolio. The ideal candidate brings deep statistical expertise, strong scientific communication skills, and a proven track record of applying innovative methodologies to oncology clinical trial design in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment. PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES: Study Design and Statistical Strategy: Lead the statistical design and analytical planning for oncology clinical utility studies. Provide technical expertise in complex study design methodologies and data analyses. Propose and justify efficient study designs tailored to complex oncology use cases. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Serve as study statistician for multiple studies. Collaborate with clinical, medical, and translational partners to influence study planning, development, and execution. Identify risks, proactively communicate concerns, and champion solutions to interdisciplinary teams and executive leaders. Documentation and Reporting: Author and review high-quality statistical deliverables, including statistical analysis plans (SAPs), and reports (TLFs, CSRs, publications) for cross-functional collaborators and stakeholders. Innovation and Improvement: Recommend and apply novel statistical approaches where appropriate. Mentor early career statisticians and support continuous improvement of departmental processes, tools, and templates to enhance team efficiency and analytical rigor. Collaborate on manuscripts for publications. QUALIFICATIONS: Advanced degree in Biostatistics, Statistics, or a related quantitative field (Ph.D. preferred). 4+ years of experience in clinical trial biostatistics. Strong expertise in time-to-event analysis, including handling of censoring, competing risks, and advanced survival modeling approaches commonly used in oncology. Expertise with innovative study design (e.g. adaptive and biomarker-informed designs), power calculations, and endpoint evaluation. Working knowledge of ICH and GCP guidelines as well as CDISC standards (e.g. SDTM, ADaM). Proficient in R. KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES: Expert-level ability to independently design clinical studies, grounded in deep domain knowledge and a nuanced understanding of complex, oncology-specific challenges. Experience with biomarker enabled clinical study designs, sample size determination, and endpoint evaluation. Demonstrated ability and enthusiasm for working in fast-paced, cross-functional environments with collaborators from diverse technical backgrounds. Ability to communicate complex statistical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences. Preferred qualifications: Working-knowledge of NGS-based diagnostics and ctDNA/MRD. Experience with non-inferiority studies. cold_email.subject: Interest in Lead Biostatistician (Oncology Clinical Studies) — biology/bioinformatics graduate
cold_email.body:
Dear Natera Hiring Team,

My name is Celina Lin, and I recently completed my Honours Bachelor of Science in Biology/Bioinformatics at the University of Waterloo. I am reaching out about the Lead Biostatistician (Oncology Clinical Studies) opportunity with Natera at Natera.

I am especially interested in the group's effort to integrate multi-omic and clinical data with AI for biomarker and therapeutic discovery. In my independent BRCA1/BRCA2 project, I built a reproducible Python and Snakemake workflow using BCFtools and ANNOVAR to analyze population-specific variants and examine discrepancies between clinical labels and observed allele frequencies. I also completed two bioinformatics internships at the Ontario Institute for Cancer Research, where I developed an LLM-assisted competency-mapping pipeline and created research-data-management learning resources. More broadly, my background in bioinformatics, pipeline development, and an LLM-assisted competency-mapping project has made me especially interested in rigorous, interpretable AI for biomedical data.

The combination of rigorous biological questions, collaborative research, and hands-on computational work in this role is exactly the environment in which I hope to grow. I would be grateful for a 15–20 minute conversation to learn more about the lab's current priorities and discuss where my background could be useful. I have attached my resume for context.

Best,
Celina Lin

The Image Generation team is responsible for one of the fastest-growing experiences in ChatGPT, enabling users to create, edit, and transform images through natural language. We work at the intersection of research, infrastructure, and product to build the systems that power image generation at global scale. Our team partners closely with researchers, product engineers, designers, and platform teams to bring state-of-the-art image capabilities to millions of users while continuously pushing the boundaries of what AI-powered creation can do. About the Role We are looking for an experienced Backend Engineer to join the Image Generation team and help build the systems that power image creation and editing across ChatGPT. You'll work on the core backend infrastructure that enables users to generate, edit, and iterate on visual content using cutting-edge multimodal AI models. This includes building highly scalable services, orchestration systems, APIs, storage platforms, and distributed infrastructure that support billions of image generations and editing workflows. You'll partner closely with product, research, and mobile teams to transform breakthrough AI capabilities into reliable, performant experiences used by millions around the world. jobs.title: Care Coordinator
jobs.description: Hi, we're Oscar. We're hiring a Care Coordinator to join our team. Oscar is the first health insurance company built around a full stack technology platform and a relentless focus on serving our members. We started Oscar in 2012 to create the kind of health insurance company we would want for ourselves—one that behaves like a doctor in the family. About the role: Care Coordinators serve as the central entry point and operational backbone for the Care Management department. They provide comprehensive care coordination for members, including those in Complex Care Management (CCM), Readmission Prevention (RAP), and those who do not fit into existing highly specialized programming. By taking ownership of administrative tasks, managing post-discharge transportation needs, and resolving inbound inquiries with a focus on one-call resolution, the Care Coordination Team allows our RN Care Managers to operate at the top of their license and helps members reach their optimum health goals in the most cost effective way. Work Location: This is a remote position, open to candidates who reside in: Arizona; Florida; Georgia and Texas. While your daily work will be completed from your home office, occasional travel may be required for team meetings and company events. Pay Transparency: The base pay for this role is: $17.91 - $23.51 per year. You are also eligible for employee benefits, monthly vacation accrual at a rate of 15 days per year. Responsibilities: Be the primary bridge and entry point for all members and providers working with the Care Management team. Field inbound phone calls from members and providers, using optimized IVR pathways to ensure accurate routing and striving for one-call resolution. Manage care coordination for members across various programs, including CCM, TOC, and unassigned populations, across a variety of settings (hospitals, outpatient clinics, home care, supply vendors, dialysis) while maintaining strict confidentiality and the highest level of professionalism. Manage non-emergent medical transportation (NEMT) via UberHealth for members, strictly following program guardrails to decrease readmissions and improve health outcomes. Handle internal escalations to specialized departments such as Claims, Eligibility, and Care Navigation. Lead special projects as subject matter experts. Collaborate cross-departmentally to create a positive member experience. Perform all other tasks or additional responsibilities. Requirements: 1+ years of experience with care coordination and navigation in a healthcare setting. Proficient computer literacy skills, with a strong aptitude for using EMRs (like Medecision) and telephony systems (like InContact) for seamless workflows. Excellent interpersonal communication skills including exceptional listening skills. Bonus points: Certified as a Medical Assistant Bilingual Familiar with Health Insurance This is an authentic Oscar Health job opportunity. Learn more about how you can safeguard yourself from recruitment fraud here . At Oscar, being an Equal Opportunity Employer means more than upholding discrimination-free hiring practices. It means that we cultivate an environment where people can be their most authentic selves and find both belonging and support. Reasonable Accommodation: Oscar applicants are considered solely based on their qualifications, without regard to applicant’s disability or need for accommodation. About the Role: As a Catering Concierge Specialist, you'll be the dedicated point of contact for our highest-touch catering customers. You'll take a customer's event details — headcount, budget, dietary needs, occasion — and turn them into a curated menu and a fully coordinated order, working directly with restaurants and support specialists to make sure everything lands exactly as requested. You'll also help shape and improve the Concierge experience itself as we scale this service across new markets and customer segments. You're excited about this opportunity because you will… Own the customer relationship from intake through delivery, anticipating needs and catching issues before they become problems. Recommend restaurants and build custom menus tailored to each customer's use case, headcount, and dietary requirements. Collaborate with restaurants and Dashers to ensure large, complex orders are prepared and delivered correctly and on time — including going onsite when needed. Work cross-functionally with Sales, Post-Sales/CSM, and Support teams to route customers to the right experience and flag expansion opportunities. Help build and refine the operating processes behind Concierge as the program grows, with the opportunity to take on more strategic work as the program matures. Your responsibilities as part of your scope include but are not limited to: Respond to Concierge intake requests (via form, email, or Slack) within 24 business hours with curated restaurant and menu recommendations. Manage the full order lifecycle for assigned customers — from menu confirmation through order placement, coordination, and post-delivery follow-up. Proactively communicate with customers, merchants, and Dashers via phone, email, or chat to resolve issues on complex or large-format orders. Be available to go onsite to restaurants or customer locations when needed to ensure an order goes smoothly. Log customer details, order cadence, and account context accurately in internal systems (e.g., Salesforce) to support account continuity and expansion tracking. Create and maintain documentation for Concierge SOPs, flagging gaps and building new process docs as the service scales. Support new operational pilots and process improvements for the Concierge program. Use AI tools to work more efficiently — whether for research, drafting, or streamlining repetitive parts of the job. We're excited about you because… You have 2+ years of experience in customer support, hospitality, account management, program management, or a related client-facing role. You're comfortable with — and excited to use — AI tools in your day-to-day work. This is a high-autonomy role for someone who thrives in complexity and ambiguity. You know recruiting well enough to feel where it breaks, and you're energized by holding several very different problems at once and driving each to a clear resolution. Key responsibilities Take on recruiting's biggest ambiguous bets: define the problem, ship the smallest testable version, and hand each one off as a repeatable program before moving to the next Own the operating rhythm across the teams that support recruiting, so we plan, review, and decide as one function Spot recurring friction and fix the system behind it, not just the case in front of you Own process design when company-wide changes run through recruiting, and drive them to real adoption with the partners who own the build and the comms Be recruiting's DRI for headcount and workforce planning, including hiring pace and readiness for new regions Own the operating standard for interviewing, like scheduling lead time and interviewer load, and lead the cross-team diagnosis when it slips Turn analytics into standards and simple SOPs, and build documentation a new leader could pick up without you in the room Keep the right people informed at the right time without becoming a bottleneck, and stay fluent in our recruiting systems and data so you can call the downstream impact of any decision You'll partner directly with the leads for Recruiting Systems, Analytics, Interview Programs, and other teams. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences. jobs.description: Career Category Operations Job Description Join Amgen’s Mission of Serving Patients At Amgen, if you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission—to serve patients living with serious illnesses—drives all that we do. Since 1980, we’ve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world’s toughest diseases. With our focus on four therapeutic areas –Oncology, Inflammation, General Medicine, and Rare Disease– we reach millions of patients each year. Amgen is advancing a broad and deep pipeline of medicines to treat cancer, heart disease, inflammatory conditions, rare diseases, and obesity and obesity-related conditions. As a member of the Amgen team, you’ll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives. Our award-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lay within them, you’ll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career. Associate Manufacturing - Nights What you will do Let’s do this. Let’s change the world. In this vital role you will perform operations within the Manufacturing area, specifically solutions, at Amgen's innovative Rhode Island facility. You will be required to know, comprehend, and apply Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP), as well as understand, follow, and document in batch records. Responsibilities Include: Perform batching and transfer of Buffers and Media in appropriate areas according to Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs). Follow and monitor critical processes, complete routine validation protocols, and regularly draft and revise documents such as Manufacturing Procedures, SOPs, and technical reports. Conduct basic troubleshooting and assist in the review of documentation for assigned functions. May also have the responsibility of initiating and owning area Deviations, revising SOP's and performing LEAN functions. Identify, recommend, and implement improvements related to routine functions. In this role, you will be expected to work a 12-hour shift (7PM-7AM) on a rotating schedule. This includes extra benefits such as receiving an added 15% shift differential, and also getting premium pay for any Sundays worked. The schedule during the initial on-boarding/training phase (2-6 weeks) will be administrative (Monday through Friday, approximately 8am to 5pm). What we expect of you We are all different, yet we all use our unique contributions to serve patients. The driven professional we seek is a self-starter with these qualifications. Basic Qualifications: High school/GED + 2 years of manufacturing or operations work experience OR Associate’s + 6 months of manufacturing or operations work experience OR Bachelor’s Degree in a related field Preferred Qualifications: Bachelor’s degree in Science or Engineering Knowledge of large-scale biotechnology operations such as purification, cell culture, aseptic processing, etc. Knowledge of Single-use-Systems CFR and Regulatory knowledge Mechanical ability/expertise Basic statistical mathematical skills Ability to interpret and apply GMP knowledge Understanding of analytical methods for manufacturing area Demonstrated technical writing capability Able to demonstrate project management skills and presentation skills Ability to understand, apply and evaluate basic chemistry, biology and physical principles Basic troubleshooting skills on production equipment Experience with Delta V Experience with lab equipment/testing What you can expect of us As we work to develop treatments that take care of others, we also work to care for your professional and personal growth and well-being. From our competitive benefits to our collaborative culture, we’ll support your journey every step of the way. The expected annual salary range for this role in the U.S. (excluding Puerto Rico) is posted. Actual salary will vary based on several factors including but not limited to, relevant skills, experience, and qualifications. You will not be penalized for redacting or removing this information. Application deadline Amgen does not have an application deadline for this position; we will continue accepting applications until we receive a sufficient number or select a candidate for the position. cold_email.subject: Interest in Associate Manufacturing - Nights (D or C shift) — biology/bioinformatics graduate
cold_email.body:
Dear Amgen Hiring Team,

My name is Celina Lin, and I recently completed my Honours Bachelor of Science in Biology/Bioinformatics at the University of Waterloo. I am reaching out about the Associate Manufacturing - Nights (D or C shift) opportunity with Amgen at Amgen.

I am especially interested in the team's use of quantitative and computational methods to answer meaningful biological questions. In my independent BRCA1/BRCA2 project, I built a reproducible Python and Snakemake workflow using BCFtools and ANNOVAR to analyze population-specific variants and examine discrepancies between clinical labels and observed allele frequencies. I also completed two bioinformatics internships at the Ontario Institute for Cancer Research, where I developed an LLM-assisted competency-mapping pipeline and created research-data-management learning resources. More broadly, my background in biology, bioinformatics, Python, R, SQL, Linux, and reproducible workflow development aligns well with that kind of cross-disciplinary work.

The combination of rigorous biological questions, collaborative research, and hands-on computational work in this role is exactly the environment in which I hope to grow. I would be grateful for a 15–20 minute conversation to learn more about the lab's current priorities and discuss where my background could be useful. I have attached my resume for context.

Best,
Celina Lin
https://linkedin.com/in/celina-g-lin

jobs.title: Lead Biostatistician (Oncology Clinical Studies)
jobs.description: This is an exciting opportunity for a highly experienced, independent clinical biostatistician to advance adoption of Natera’s oncology portfolio of cutting-edge molecular diagnostic tests. As a Lead Biostatistician, you will independently lead the design, analysis, and reporting for multiple practice-changing oncology clinical trials. You will propose efficient, fit-for-purpose study designs with broad impact across the oncology portfolio. The ideal candidate brings deep statistical expertise, strong scientific communication skills, and a proven track record of applying innovative methodologies to oncology clinical trial design in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment. PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES: Study Design and Statistical Strategy: Lead the statistical design and analytical planning for oncology clinical utility studies. Provide technical expertise in complex study design methodologies and data analyses. Propose and justify efficient study designs tailored to complex oncology use cases. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Serve as study statistician for multiple studies. Collaborate with clinical, medical, and translational partners to influence study planning, development, and execution. Identify risks, proactively communicate concerns, and champion solutions to interdisciplinary teams and executive leaders. Documentation and Reporting: Author and review high-quality statistical deliverables, including statistical analysis plans (SAPs), and reports (TLFs, CSRs, publications) for cross-functional collaborators and stakeholders. Innovation and Improvement: Recommend and apply novel statistical approaches where appropriate. Mentor early career statisticians and support continuous improvement of departmental processes, tools, and templates to enhance team efficiency and analytical rigor. Collaborate on manuscripts for publications. QUALIFICATIONS: Advanced degree in Biostatistics, Statistics, or a related quantitative field (Ph.D. preferred). 4+ years of experience in clinical trial biostatistics. Strong expertise in time-to-event analysis, including handling of censoring, competing risks, and advanced survival modeling approaches commonly used in oncology. Expertise with innovative study design (e.g. adaptive and biomarker-informed designs), power calculations, and endpoint evaluation. Working knowledge of ICH and GCP guidelines as well as CDISC standards (e.g. SDTM, ADaM). Proficient in R. KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES: Expert-level ability to independently design clinical studies, grounded in deep domain knowledge and a nuanced understanding of complex, oncology-specific challenges. Experience with biomarker enabled clinical study designs, sample size determination, and endpoint evaluation. Demonstrated ability and enthusiasm for working in fast-paced, cross-functional environments with collaborators from diverse technical backgrounds. Ability to communicate complex statistical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences. Preferred qualifications: Working-knowledge of NGS-based diagnostics and ctDNA/MRD. Experience with non-inferiority studies. Compensation & Total Rewards This range reflects a good-faith estimate of the base pay we reasonably expect to offer at the time of hire. Final compensation will vary based on experience, qualifications, and internal equity considerations. This position is also eligible for additional compensation and benefits through Natera’s robust Total Rewards program, including: Annual performance incentive bonus Long-term equity awards Comprehensive health benefits (medical, dental, vision) 401(k) with company match Generous paid time off and company holidays Additional wellness and work-life benefits Compensation Range $144,000 — $180,000 USD OUR OPPORTUNITY Natera™ is a global leader in cell-free DNA (cfDNA) testing, dedicated to oncology, women’s health, and organ health. Our aim is to make personalized genetic testing and diagnostics part of the standard of care to protect health and enable earlier and more targeted interventions that lead to longer, healthier lives. The Natera team consists of highly dedicated statisticians, geneticists, doctors, laboratory scientists, business professionals, software engineers and many other professionals from world-class institutions, who care deeply for our work and each other. When you join Natera, you’ll work hard and grow quickly. Working alongside the elite of the industry, you’ll be stretched and challenged, and take pride in being part of a company that is changing the landscape of genetic disease management. WHAT WE OFFER Competitive Benefits - Employee benefits include comprehensive medical, dental, vision, life and disability plans for eligible employees and their dependents. Additionally, Natera employees and their immediate families receive free testing in addition to fertility care benefits. Other benefits include pregnancy and baby bonding leave, 401k benefits, commuter benefits and much more. We also offer a generous employee referral program! For more information, visit www.natera.com . Natera is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to ensuring a diverse and inclusive workplace environment, and welcome people of different backgrounds, experiences, abilities and perspectives. Inclusive collaboration benefits our employees, our community and our patients, and is critical to our mission of changing the management of disease worldwide. All qualified applicants are encouraged to apply, and will be considered without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, age, veteran status, disability or any other legally protected status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with applicable laws. If you are based in California, we encourage you to read this important information for California residents. Link: https://www.natera.com/notice-of-data-collection-california-residents/ Please be advised that Natera will reach out to candidates with a @ natera.com email domain ONLY. The team works across the company to communicate clearly and thoughtfully with a wide range of audiences in a rapidly evolving environment. Within Communications, the Strategy & Systems team is building a new model for how communications organizations operate—combining strong strategic judgment, effective operating systems, and the growing capabilities of AI. We design the frameworks, tools, and ways of working that help the broader team focus on its highest-impact priorities and execute them effectively. About the Role We are looking for a Strategy & Operations Manager to help make this operating model real. You will translate priorities into action, lead high-impact initiatives from idea through implementation, and design better ways for the Communications team to work. You will take ownership of complex projects that require clear thinking, strong follow-through, and a willingness to challenge how work has traditionally been done. You will partner with senior leaders, technical builders, and cross-functional teams to bring structure to ambiguous problems, strengthen execution, and apply AI in practical ways that improve how the organization operates. This role is based in San Francisco, CA. We use a hybrid work model of three days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees. In this role, you will: - Lead strategic initiatives and special projects across Communications, turning ambiguous opportunities into clearly defined problems, aligned plans, and successful implementation. - Help shape how the team sets priorities, makes decisions, and follows through on its most important work—including launches, campaigns, reactive moments, and longer-term initiatives. - Design an AI-forward approach to project and program management, building systems that maintain momentum, surface risks early, and make ownership and dependencies clear. - Build operating rhythms, planning frameworks, and shared processes that create clarity without adding unnecessary meetings, manual tracking, or layers of coordination. - Translate emerging AI capabilities into practical workflows that reduce repetitive work, strengthen coordination, and allow team members to focus on work that most benefits from human judgment. - Drive the adoption of new tools and ways of working across the Communications organization, partnering with systems builders and team leads to understand user needs and continually improve the experience. - Work closely with senior leaders to translate strategic priorities into clear plans, decisions, milestones, and measurable outcomes. - Build strong partnerships across Communications, Marketing, Global Affairs, Product, and other teams to connect work across organizations and resolve gaps in ownership or execution. - Use data and qualitative insights to evaluate effectiveness, measure impact, and identify opportunities to improve how the team operates. - Help create a culture of clear ownership, thoughtful experimentation, continuous improvement, and high-quality execution. You might thrive in this role if you: - Have 10+ years of professional experience, including significant experience in strategy and operations, business operations, program leadership, or a related field. - Have a track record of working closely with senior leaders to drive complex, cross-functional initiatives. - Have led initiatives from an early idea or loosely defined problem through execution and measurable results. - Are energized by the opportunity to rethink how teams work with AI and have experience introducing AI tools, building AI-enabled workflows, or helping an organization adopt new ways of working. - Bring strong strategic judgment and can distinguish high-impact work from activity that creates motion without meaningful progress. - Can translate an ambiguous challenge into a clear plan, align the right stakeholders, and sustain momentum as priorities evolve. - Bring strong analytical skills and experience using data to inform decisions, measure outcomes, and improve organizational effectiveness. - Can partner effectively with technical builders and have experience using agentic, automation, or no-code tools. - Communicate clearly, build trust across functions, and exercise good judgment about when to push for a decision, simplify a process, or pursue a different approach. - Are highly organized and capable of managing multiple complex initiatives without losing sight of strategic context or execution details. - Care deeply about the work of communications and are excited to help build a team that operates at the pace and ambition of OpenAI. jobs.title: Hardware Engineer - Electronics Packaging & Vehicle Integration
jobs.description: About the Team DoorDash Labs, established in 2018, serves as the innovation hub for DoorDash, focusing on developing automation and robotics solutions to enhance last-mile logistics. The team's mission is to create technologies that support and augment human networks, aiming to improve efficiency for Dashers, merchants, and consumers alike. We’re ruthlessly focused on business impact. We are a highly senior team composed of former pioneers from a variety of different robotics industries. As of 2025, DoorDash has completed 10B lifetime deliveries. We’re focused on how to do the next 10B even better About the Role As a Hardware Engineer, Electronics Packaging & Vehicle Integration, you will lead the mechanical architecture, design, and delivery of electromechanical systems for DoorDash’s next-generation autonomous delivery vehicle. You will develop robust packaging solutions for compute, electrical, communications, and sensor-related hardware that operate reliably in demanding real-world fleet environments. This role sits at the intersection of mechanical engineering, vehicle integration, and product reliability. You will partner closely with electrical engineering, PCB design, industrial design, systems engineering, manufacturing, supplier partners, reliability, and operations teams to turn system requirements into durable, manufacturable, serviceable, and cost-effective product designs. You will own designs from concept through launch, including electronic enclosures, housings, mounting systems, seals, connector interfaces, and vehicle-level integration features. Success in this role requires strong mechanical design judgment, practical experience with production processes, and the ability to resolve cross-functional packaging tradeoffs. Responsibilities: Own the mechanical design and release of electronic packaging, housings, enclosures, and vehicle integration solutions in support of program timing and product launch. Design components and assemblies including castings, injection-molded parts, stampings, seals, brackets, PCBA mounts, connector interfaces, and vehicle mounting interfaces. Create and maintain production-quality 3D CAD and drawings; lead CAD design reviews with cross-functional stakeholders. Define mechanical requirements and interfaces for electrical, compute, communications, and other electromechanical subsystems. Perform design calculations, GD&T development, tolerance stack-ups, and other engineering analyses needed to validate design intent. Develop and execute analysis and test plans for new designs, including proof-of-concept builds, bench testing, and design validation activities. Partner with electrical engineers and PCB designers to integrate components into reliable, manufacturable electromechanical assemblies. Lead DFx activities with manufacturing and supplier partners, incorporating design-for-manufacturing, assembly, serviceability, reliability, and cost considerations. Identify design risks, drive technical tradeoff decisions, and communicate design progress, issues, and mitigation plans to program stakeholders. Support supplier engagement, prototype builds, root-cause investigations, and continuous product improvement through launch and fleet deployment. You’re excited about this opportunity because you will… Contribute materially to the form and function of a high profile delivery robot— your work will be on display for all to see and interact with You want to build products that millions of people interact with—not just drive. Every engineering decision directly impacts the customer experience.You're energized by solving first-of-their-kind engineering problems at the intersection of robotics, automotive engineering, and logistics.You enjoy working on products that move quickly from concept to real-world deployment, where engineering decisions immediately translate into operational impact.You believe autonomous delivery has the potential to fundamentally reshape local commerce by making deliveries safer, more sustainable, and more affordable.You're excited to join a highly collaborative team where mechanical engineering plays a central role in defining the future of autonomous last-mile delivery. We’re excited about you because… Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related field. 6+ years of experience designing electromechanical products, electronics packaging, vehicle systems, robotics, automotive systems, or other ruggedized hardware from concept through production. Experience packaging compute, electrical, communications, sensor, or power-electronics hardware into mechanically robust assemblies and enclosures. Strong mechanical design experience with components and processes such as die castings, injection moldings, stampings, extrusions, machined parts, seals, gaskets, brackets, and welded assemblies. Experience integrating PCBAs, connectors, wire harnesses, cooling solutions, and serviceable electrical interfaces into complete electromechanical systems. Deep understanding of design for manufacturability, assembly, serviceability, reliability, cost, and supplier capability. Extensive CAD experience, preferably NX, Team Center, with SolidWorks or CATIA also welcomed; able to create robust parametric models, detailed drawings, and complex assemblies. Strong command of GD&T, tolerance analysis, stack-ups, datum strategy, and interface definition for assemblies with multiple mechanical and electrical contributors. Familiarity with structural design, vibration, shock, fatigue, ingress protection, corrosion prevention, and environmental sealing for outdoor or vehicle-mounted products. Ability to use engineering fundamentals and data to make design decisions; experience with FEA, hand calculations, test data analysis, MATLAB, Python, or similar tools is a plus. Experience developing and executing design verification plans, proof-of-concept testing, and root-cause investigations. Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional technical discussions and resolve packaging tradeoffs across mechanical, electrical, systems, manufacturing, reliability, and operations teams. Comfortable moving between CAD design reviews, supplier discussions, prototype builds, test execution, and hands-on troubleshooting on the shop floor. Experience with commercial vehicles, autonomous vehicles, robotics, or other high-duty-cycle fleet products is strongly preferred. jobs.title: Technical Architect
jobs.location: Remote-Friendly (Travel-Required) | San Francisco, CA | Seattle, WA | New York City, NY
jobs.description: About Anthropic Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About the role Claude Code is changing how engineering organizations build software, and most of them need someone to show them how. That's you. Technical Architects help customers get real work done with Claude Code, Claude Tag (Claude Code as an agent in Slack), and the enterprise admin controls that decide whether a rollout succeeds. You'll teach customers, partners and Anthropic's own field teams. Just as important, you'll train the trainers who carry that knowledge to everyone else. We're hands-on AI engineers who would rather teach than sell. You'll work alongside customer engineering organizations, teaching them about Claude Code and shepherding rollouts with advanced admin knowledge. Most weeks you're in front of an audience with Claude Desktop or a terminal open: thousands of engineers on a public webinar one day, a customer's platform team in their own conference room the next week, office hours in between. The prep material often reaches you the day before. The team is growing quickly this year, scope will grow as new products ship, and the people who join now will shape how it works. Responsibilities Teach in every format. Take a standing rotation on Anthropic's public webinars in front of thousands of engineers at a time. Lead workshops and multi-day onsites, in person and virtual, built around a customer's own codebase and questions. Host office hours and multi-week cohorts where engineers, partners, and account teams bring live problems. Teach the teachers. Run train-the-trainer programs for customer technologists and champions, and certify them to deliver Anthropic's material. Empower admins. Educate enterprise admins on the technical requirements for a strong rollout by guiding them through single sign-on, permissions, connectors, spend controls, data-handling policy, and other advanced topics. Build fast with Claude. Turn a request into a polished deck, demo repository or plugin within a day, using the tools you teach. Explore new features the day they ship. Pick up a teammate's material and deliver it as if you wrote it. Bring field signal back to product. Tell the Claude Code, Claude Tag and Cowork teams what customers run into, specifically enough that they can fix it. Be the technical voice in the room. Partner with account executives, customer success managers, Applied AI Architects, support engineers and partner leads. Travel. Expect 30 to 50%, in bursts around onsites, workshops and events. You may be a good fit if you have 5+ years as a software engineer, solutions architect, developer advocate or similar. You still ship code and regularly teach engineering audiences. Current engineering range. You've shipped code other people depend on. You can go deep with a senior engineer anywhere in the stack. You use Claude Code or a similar agentic tool every day and have opinions about it. Big-stage presence. You've held large live audiences. You sound practiced with material you got that morning, and a broken demo doesn’t faze you. Range in one conversation. You can go from banter to a rigorous design discussion, and both feel natural. Care for people. You do right by a struggling customer, and you won't leave a confused room behind. Initiative. You build things without waiting for permission, and you say when an idea is half-formed, including your manager's. Steadiness when priorities shift, timelines are short and colleagues are under pressure. Comfort with ambiguity in a fast-moving industry and product suite. A stake in safe AI. You care that large organizations deploy AI responsibly, and you want to help them do it. You love being on the frontier. You want to work at the edge of what’s possible and help define what comes next. Strong candidates may also have Depth in enterprise identity and security review (SAML, OIDC, SCIM, SOC 2, HIPAA). Experience running Claude on Amazon Bedrock or Google Cloud Vertex AI. Time with regulated industries or with systems-integrator partners. A public record of technical teaching: talks, courses, videos or writing. An interest outside technology you can talk about with the same energy. The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. Annual Salary: $250,000 — $365,000 USD Logistics Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices. Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team. Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings. How we're different We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills. The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences. Come work with us! Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

We invite you to submit your résumé in French. When an English version is available, you may also include it to facilitate communication with certain teams within our international organization. Le rôle: Se joindre à Moderna, c’est faire progresser la science de l’ARNm pour transformer la médecine. Travaillez avec des équipes mondiales exceptionnelles sur un vaste portefeuille de programmes et bâtissez une carrière qui fait une réelle différence pour les patients. Dans ce rôle basé à Laval, vous contribuerez directement aux opérations de fabrication commerciale d’ARNm en assurant un leadership de proximité au sein des activités de production. Vous dirigerez une équipe hautement qualifiée tout en demeurant activement impliqué dans les opérations quotidiennes, afin de garantir l’excellence opérationnelle, la conformité réglementaire et la performance de fabrication. Cette opportunité vous permettra d’évoluer au cœur d’un environnement manufacturier innovant, où l’amélioration continue, les technologies de pointe, la transformation numérique et les outils émergents, incluant l’intelligence artificielle générative, contribuent à accélérer l’impact des médicaments à ARNm pour les patients. Voici ce que vous ferez: Gestion des opérations et de la production Gérer l’ensemble des opérations de production ainsi que son équipe. Participer activement aux activités de fabrication tout en assurant la supervision des opérations quotidiennes. Suivre la performance de l’équipe conformément aux indicateurs clés de performance (KPI) en place et prendre les mesures nécessaires au besoin. Collaborer étroitement avec la chaîne d’approvisionnement (Supply Chain) pour la planification des calendriers de production, la gestion des stocks et l’optimisation des capacités manufacturières.
